how many players does a soccer team have: A soccer team has 11 players on the field at once, including the goalkeeper. A match can be played with as few as seven per side before it must be abandoned.
in which sport do you score a \"home run: A home run in baseball is when the batter hits the ball out of play, usually over the outfield fence, and gets to run all the bases and score. It's the most exciting hit in the sport.
which player holds the nhl record of 2,8: Wayne Gretzky, nicknamed "The Great One", holds the NHL record of 2,857 career points, made up of 894 goals and 1,963 assists. No other player has reached even 2,000.
which of these nhl teams originally play: The Calgary Flames began as the Atlanta Flames in 1972 and moved to Canada in 1980. Atlanta later got a new team, the Thrashers, who moved to Winnipeg in 2011.
who won the uefa champions league in 201: Real Madrid won the 2017 Champions League final, beating Juventus 4-1 in Cardiff. They became the first team to win the title in back-to-back seasons since the competition was renamed in 1992.
in what sport is a \"shuttlecock\" used?: A shuttlecock, or "birdie", is the feathered or plastic projectile that players hit in badminton. It's shaped to fly in a stable way, with the heavy cork end first.
in the 2014 fifa world cup, what was the: Germany beat Brazil 7-1 in the 2014 World Cup semifinal in Belo Horizonte. It is one of the most shocking results in World Cup history, and Germany went on to win the title.
the los angeles dodgers were originally: The Dodgers began in Brooklyn and moved to Los Angeles after the 1957 season. The name comes from Brooklyn residents who had to "dodge" the trolleys.
what was the year of estabilishment of t: Bari, a football club from southern Italy, was founded in 1908. It has spent most of its history moving between Serie A and the lower divisions.
how many players are there in an associa: A soccer (association football) team has 11 players on the field, including the goalkeeper. Each side may also name substitutes on the bench.
what national team won the first uefa na: Portugal won the first UEFA Nations League in 2019 by beating the Netherlands 1-0 in the final in Porto. The tournament was created to make international friendlies more meaningful.
who did steven gerrard win the champions: Steven Gerrard won the Champions League with Liverpool in 2005, captaining a team that came back from 3-0 down at halftime to beat AC Milan on penalties in Istanbul. It's called the "Miracle of Istanbul".
\"stadium of light\" is the home stadium: The Stadium of Light is Sunderland's ground in northeast England and opened in 1997. Its name honors the region's mining history and the miners' lamps.
in baseball, how many fouls are an out?: A foul ball counts as a strike but cannot count as the third strike, except for a bunt. So a batter generally cannot strike out by hitting foul balls, no matter how many.
which of these nhl teams have never move: The St. Louis Blues joined the NHL in 1967 as part of its first expansion and have stayed in the same city ever since. They won their first Stanley Cup in 2019.
in formula 1, the virtual safety car was: The Virtual Safety Car was introduced in Formula 1 after Jules Bianchi's fatal crash at the 2014 Japanese Grand Prix. It makes every driver slow down to a set pace while a hazard is cleared.
which nba player has the most games play: Robert Parish played 1,611 NBA games over 21 seasons and held the record for most games for decades. Newer players such as LeBron James have since challenged his mark.
hockey player wayne gretzky was born in: Wayne Gretzky was born in Brantford, Ontario, in 1961. He learned to skate on a backyard rink that his father flooded every winter.
at which bridge does the annual oxford a: The Oxford-Cambridge Boat Race starts at Putney Bridge and finishes near Chiswick Bridge in Mortlake, covering about 4.2 miles of the Thames. The tradition goes back to 1829.
in what year did steaua bucurești win th: Steaua Bucharest won the 1986 European Cup by beating Barcelona on penalties in Seville after a 0-0 draw. Their goalkeeper, Helmuth Duckadam, saved all four Barcelona penalties.
which professional wrestler fell from th: Owen Hart died at the WWF's Over the Edge event in Kansas City on May 23, 1999, when a harness release failed during a stunt to lower him into the ring from the rafters. It led to a lot of discussion about safety in wrestling.
what is tiger woods' all-time best caree: Tiger Woods' lowest competitive round is generally cited as 61. A typical tournament win takes four rounds in the high 60s.
who won the 2018 monaco grand prix?: Daniel Ricciardo won the 2018 Monaco Grand Prix for Red Bull even though a power problem cut his engine's output in the middle of the race. He kept control to hold off Sebastian Vettel.
who was the topscorer for england nation: Wayne Rooney was England's all-time top scorer with 53 goals until Harry Kane passed him in 2023. Kane has kept adding to the record.
which nba player won most valuable playe: Shaquille O'Neal won the 1999-2000 NBA MVP award with the Los Angeles Lakers, averaging about 30 points and 13 rebounds per game. He got all but one first-place vote.
which country is hosting the 2022 fifa w: Qatar hosted the 2022 World Cup, the first one in the Arab world and the first held in November and December to avoid the summer heat. Argentina, led by Lionel Messi, won the title.
what is the exact length of one non-curv: On a standard 400 m running track, each straight is 84.39 m long in lane 1. The two curved sections make up the rest of the lap.
who has played the most tournaments in t: Lothar Matthäus played 150 times for Germany, a record for his country. He played in five World Cups and captained West Germany to the 1990 title.
which of the following player scored a h: Wayne Rooney scored a hat-trick on his Manchester United debut against Fenerbahçe in 2004, just after joining from Everton at age 18. It's one of the most famous debuts in the club's history.
which of these countries' national teams: Tunisia qualified for the 2018 World Cup in Russia as one of Africa's five representatives. Other qualifiers from the continent were Egypt, Morocco, Nigeria and Senegal.
which of these russian cities did not co: The 2018 World Cup was played in 11 Russian cities, including Moscow, Saint Petersburg, Kazan and Sochi. Vladivostok, on the Pacific coast, was not among them.
which year was the third super bowl held: Super Bowl III was played in January 1969, and the New York Jets of the AFL upset the heavily favored Baltimore Colts. Jets quarterback Joe Namath had famously guaranteed a win.
who scored the injury time winning goal: Ole Gunnar Solskjær scored the winning goal in injury time at the 1999 Champions League final against Bayern Munich. United had trailed until the 91st minute and completed a famous treble that season.
who is manchester united's leading appea: Ryan Giggs holds the record for most Manchester United appearances, with 963 in more than 20 years. He won 13 Premier League titles with the club.
which italian footballer told neuer wher: In the Euro 2016 quarterfinal shootout, Italy's Graziano Pellè told Manuel Neuer where he planned to shoot and then missed wide. Germany won the shootout 6-5 after a 1-1 draw.
in canadian football, scoring a rouge is: In Canadian football a rouge is worth one point. It's scored when the ball is kicked into the opponent's end zone and isn't returned out.
which female player won the gold medal o: Ding Ning of China won the women's singles table tennis gold at the 2016 Rio Olympics, beating her teammate Li Xiaoxia in the final. It completed her career Grand Slam.
with which doubles partner did john mcen: John McEnroe won most of his doubles titles with Peter Fleming, and the pair won seven Grand Slam doubles titles together. They were ranked the best team in the world in the early 1980s.
